name_input: SUKHJIT STARCH MILLS; SUKHJIT STARCH MILLS; THE SUKHJIT AGRO INDUSTRIES; THE SUKHJIT AGRO IND.; THE SUKHJIT STARCH AND CHEMICALS LTD; SUKHJIT CORN PRODUCTS ( A UNIT OF THE SUKHJIT STARCH AND CHEMICALS LIMITED); SUKHJIT STARCH MILLS; SUKHJIT STARCH INDUSTRIES
court_cases: Litigation exists but is overwhelmingly tax/regulatory, not criminal or sanctions-related. Indian Kanoon search for 'Sukhjit Starch' returns 95 documents (checked 10 on first page, https://indiankanoon.org/search/?formInput=Sukhjit+Starch). Company as PETITIONER/APPELLANT: The Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals Ltd vs State of Punjab & Others, Punjab & Haryana HC, decided 03.09.2008 (civil writ); Sukhjit Starch And Chemicals Ltd vs Commissioner Of Income-Tax, P&H HC, 08.07.1996 ([1996]221ITR308(P&H)); Sukhjit Starch And Chemicals Ltd vs Deputy Commissioner Of Income Tax, ITAT Amritsar, 30.04.2004; Sukhjit Starch & Chem. Ltd vs Supdt., C.Ex., Range-II, Phagwara, P&H HC, 29.09.1998; M/s The Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals Ltd vs Commissioner Of Central Excise, CESTAT Delhi, 14.02.2001 (stay petition); Sukhjit Starch And Chemicals Ltd vs State Of Punjab And Ors, P&H HC, 10.11.1961 (industrial dispute with workmen, AIR1962P&H553). Company as RESPONDENT: Commissioner Of Income Tax-II vs M/s Sukhjit Starch & Chemicals Ltd, P&H HC, 08.02.2016; Commissioner Of Central Excise vs Sukhjit Starch And Chemicals Ltd, CESTAT Delhi, 12.05.2000; The Agriculture Produce Market Committee, Una vs M/s Sukhjit Starch And Chemicals Ltd, Himachal Pradesh HC, 15.12.2022 (Bench: Sabina, Sushil Kukreja). No criminal proceedings, no sanctions enforcement, no fraud/insolvency proceedings found in the retrieved set. Status of most matters: decided/disposed (per judgment dates); current pendency not verified. NOTE: only page 1 of 10 of the Kanoon result set was reviewed - the remaining ~85 documents were not opened, so this list is not exhaustive.
news_risk: No negative news, regulator action or enforcement item found. The company's own site (https://www.sukhjitgroup.com/) presents routine corporate disclosures: SEBI LODR Reg. 30 announcements, IEPF share-transfer notices, unclaimed dividend, buyback, CSR - all standard listed-company housekeeping, not adverse. No SEBI/ROC/ED/CBI action located. Caveat: the DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable for the entire session ('Connection refused'), so no open-web negative-news sweep was possible; absence of findings here reflects tool failure, not a clean bill of health.
note: RISK-ONLY SCOPE. Sanctions: NOT VERIFIED - null, not 'clear'. The OFAC Sanctions List Search page (https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/) was reachable but is a JavaScript form; no query could be executed, so no SDN/Non-SDN match was actually run. UN, EU, UK OFSI and BIS Entity List were not checked at all. Do not treat null as a negative result. Credit rating: NOT VERIFIED - the company maintains a dedicated Credit Rating page (https://www.sukhjitgroup.com/credit-rating) but its content is JS-rendered and returned no rating text; CRISIL rating-list lookup returned a 404 and BSE page returned only a JS shell. Rating agency, symbol and date therefore null - must be pulled from the company's rating page or the agency site manually. RF/CIS supply: no evidence found either way - null. Company is a listed Indian corn-wet-milling manufacturer (maize starch, dextrose, sorbitol, liquid glucose) with units at Phagwara (Punjab), Nizamabad (Telangana), Malda (West Bengal) and Gurplah (HP); products are food/pharma-grade and no Russia/CIS counterparty, export record or re-export signal surfaced in the sources read. Per project rule 2, the tax and excise litigation listed above is NOT a rejection ground and is recorded neutrally - it is ordinary Indian tax/regulatory history for a company incorporated in 1943. No rejection trigger (non-existence, liquidation, bankruptcy) observed. Research was materially constrained: web_search was down for all attempts and several databases (ZaubaCorp 403, BSE/CRISIL JS-gated) were inaccessible; recommend a re-run of sanctions screening and rating retrieval before final use.
